draft.subject: Getting Silver Analytics' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks again for the API question earlier — list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so that one's covered, and your ticket is closed on our side. If anything there is still open-ended, just say the word.

On the setup itself: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually the step that makes the rest click. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time too.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
